entities.summary: Paraguay is a sovereign nation in South America, Americas. Its capital is Asunción. Official languages include Spanish, Guaraní. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 6.9 million. Area: 406,752 km². Comprehensive index for Paraguay covering Guaraní peoples (unique cultural dominance), Jesuit Reductions (1610-1767, expelled), Spanish colonization, independence 1811, Francia dictatorship (El Supremo, 1814-40 isolation), López father/son (Carlos Antonio/Francisco Solano), War of the Triple Alliance 1864-70 (most destructive war in South American history, ~60-70% population died, male population decimated), Colorado vs Liberal conflict, Chaco War 1932-35 (vs Bolivia), Stroessner dictatorship 1954-89 (35 years), Lugo leftist president, and bilingual Guaraní-Spanish culture.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The War of the Triple Alliance (1864-1870) resulted in the deaths of approximately 60-70% of Paraguay's population and decimated its male population, making it one of the most destructive wars in South American history. This devastating conflict had a lasting impact on Paraguay's politics and economy.
